identity.description: Gumroad is a creator commerce platform for selling products, memberships and subscriptions directly to customers. The assignment URL gumroad.com/api is its official API landing page.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe the Gumroad commerce platform and its API (n8n integration docs, Gumroad help center title, rmarescu MCP README). The official gumroad.com/api fetch returned only the word 'API' (page appears JS-rendered), so official API content was not verified directly.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code flow with a token endpoint and a refresh-token grant, per Mintlify mirror summary (unverified against official docs). n8n also uses OAuth2 with Client ID and Client Secret created from a Gumroad application under Settings > Advanced (verified via n8n docs fetch summary).
auth.token_refresh: Refresh-token grant supported per Mintlify mirror summary (unverified). Access tokens reportedly stay valid until revoked (help center snippet, unverified).
auth.scopes_notes: n8n docs say the default scope is view_sales and custom scopes can be entered. Official scope list not verified. A search snippet says the user endpoint needs a public-view scope (unverified).

api.rate_limits: Not established. One mirror says a 429 is returned when exceeded, with no numbers. Another says no hard numbers are published. Treat as unknown.
api.limitations: Official endpoint reference was not retrieved. Breadth is inferred from a community MCP server (products, sales, offer codes, user) and Mintlify mirror snippets. Rate limits are undocumented in what was read. Some of this is inferred, so treat as provisional.

claims.value: Gumroad API overview page is gumroad.com/api; the page text fetched returned only 'API', so identity rests on other sources.
Developers create an application to generate an access token (n8n integration docs).
claims.quote: Create an application to generate an access token.

claims.value: Self-hosted OAuth2 setup uses Settings > Advanced in Gumroad to create an application that produces an Application ID and Secret.
claims.quote: Create the application. Gumroad generates an Application ID and Application Secret.

claims.value: OAuth application registration is required before using the API, per the official API page search snippet.
claims.quote: To start using the API, you'll need to register your OAuth application.
claims.verify_note: quote not found in fetched source text

claims.quote: Create an application for the API - Gumroad Help Center.

claims.value: rmarescu/gumroad-mcp describes itself as a Model Context Protocol server for the Gumroad API. It is owned by a personal account, not Gumroad.
claims.quote: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Gumroad API

claims.value: keithah/gumroad-mcp is a separate community MCP server for the Gumroad API (MIT, per search snippet).
Third-party Gumroad client libraries exist (npm @deox/gumroad, Hex gumroad_elixir, Nim gumroad, beydogan/gumroad-api). None is confirmed official.
Resource subscriptions (webhook URLs registered per event type) are documented on a Mintlify mirror of the Gumroad API docs. Ping notifications also exist.
No public numeric rate limits were established.
